# Copilot Instructions

This repository is primarily a MySQL schema project.

## Primary Sources

- `messenger.sql` is the canonical schema.
- `Messenger.mwb` is the visual model.

## Change Policy

When changing schema definitions, also review:

- `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `README.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## Quality Expectations

- Keep edits minimal and targeted.
- Avoid unrelated formatting changes.
- Document compatibility impact for non-additive changes.
- Update README version history with date when release-impacting.

## Preferred Output in PRs

- concise summary
- affected tables
- compatibility notes
- migration notes
- documentation updates
